Nina (CEO): Heads-up  All-hands Friday 11:00am PT. We'll keep to 40m + 20m Q&A. Drop quick Qs here or use the form.

Omar (VP Product): I'll demo Edge routing (6m) and share migration notes.

Raj (Eng): I'll do the incident recap (4m): cache storm -> autoscaler tweaks + circuit-breaker.

Priya (Comms): Recording and slides will be posted after the meeting. I'll publish a 1-pager and FAQ.

MeetBot: Calendar invite: <https://calendar.company/evt/1912340001|All-hands Fri 11am PT>. Recording enabled.

Nina (CEO): We'll announce default retention change: hosted non-enterprise from 90d -> 30d, enterprise & private unaffected. We'll provide migration guidance.

Omar (VP Product): Request: add per-region latency slides (EU/APAC/US).

Raj (Eng): Adding ops checklist to the shared doc.

Priya (Comms): Reminder: redact customer PII if referenced.

Lina (People Ops): Please submit Qs by Thursday EOD. Pre-submitted prioritized.

MeetBot (post-meeting): Recording: https://recordings.company/1912340001 (live).
